scope: The standing exterior of Tytuvėnai Monastery Novitiate and School Remains. The visible brick wall remnants beside the southern gallery include blocked openings and a low trace of the former masonry. The recorded subsoil foundations remain unmodeled.
geometryBasis: The national heritage record locates the novitiate adjoining the southern arcade. The written survey documents brick remains on its south side and foundations mostly under sod. The model shows an estimated low visible fragment only.
